description: This file defines the BadResponseException class within the GuzzleHttp exception namespace, representing an HTTP error response (4xx or 5xx). It extends RequestException and provides methods to confirm the presence of a response and to retrieve that response.

classes.name: BadResponseException
classes.description: An exception class representing an HTTP error response, extending RequestException to include a specific response object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method to initialize the exception with message, request, response, previous exception, and handler context.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Indicates that this exception always contains a response.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response associated with this exception, narrowing the return type to ResponseInterface.
